hooks.command: D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; R="$D/.venv/bin/ruff"; if [ ! -x "$R" ]; then echo "ruff not found at $R (pip install -e '.[dev]'); skipping lint" >&2; exit 0; fi; cd "$D" && "$R" check . >&2 || { echo 'ruff check failed: fix the findings above before committing' >&2; exit 2; }

D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; E="$D/node_modules/.bin/eslint"; if [ ! -x "$E" ]; then echo "eslint not found at $E (npm ci); skipping lint" >&2; exit 0; fi; cd "$D" && "$E" . >&2 || { echo 'eslint failed: fix the findings above before committing' >&2; exit 2; }

D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; G="$D/scripts/gates.sh"; if [ ! -x "$G" ]; then echo "$G not found; skipping eval gates" >&2; exit 0; fi; "$G" --if-no-git-hook >&2 || { echo 'eval gates failed: fix the findings above before committing' >&2; exit 2; }
